note: Issue #1319 — human-authored gold ANSWERS for this corpus's 48 questions: the one input the standard LLM-as-judge design calls for that METIS did not have. The `answers` array is EMPTY ON PURPOSE. The schema, loader, validator and answer-correctness metric all ship and are tested, but a gold answer written by a model would make the metric a measurement of the judge against itself, so none has been fabricated to fill it. Until an answer is added, `pnpm eval:answer-correctness` reports the metric as NOT REPORTED with a reason, never as a score of zero. See REFERENCE-AUTHORING.md in this directory for how to add one.

answers.answer: The vault supports versioning through a byte on every portion of text, so historical rows remain readable as you migrate.
Maximum tolerable data loss on failover is 5 minutes.
The cookie attributes are httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookies. They are rotated on every refresh.
The admin endpoint returns redacted values for known secret env names and unset for missing ones.
